bio: In this modern brasserie near the train station, the setting is inviting, sleek and accented with Art Deco touches. Large floor-to-ceiling windows flood the room with light and enhance the welcoming atmosphere. The terrace is lovely too. The cuisine is predominantly French-inspired – modern in its interpretation, precisely executed and packed with flavour. Subtle Asian influences appear here and there. The menu features dishes such as beef tartare with ponzu vinaigrette, or lobster bisque with lemongrass and vanilla, as well as classic and regional specialities such as braised beef cheeks, truffle ravioli, Brussels sprout leaves and pickled beetroot, or Chateaubriand and Tomahawk steak for two or more diners.
